mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DIAGRAM ( diagram_num, group_num, title, diagram_data, created_at ) VALUES ( diagram_seq.nextVAL, #{group_num, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{diagram_data, jdbcType=CLOB}, sysdate )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO DIAGRAM d USING (SELECT #{group_num} AS group_num, #{title} AS title, #{diagram_data} AS diagram_data FROM DUAL) s ON (d.group_num = s.group_num) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET d.title = s.title, d.diagram_data = s.diagram_data, d.updated_at = sysdate WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (diagram_num, group_num, title, diagram_data, created_at) VALUES (diagram_seq.nextVAL, s.group_num, s.title, s.diagram_data, sysdate)
mapper.select: SELECT DIAGRAM_NUM, GROUP_NUM, TITLE, DIAGRAM_DATA, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM diagram WHERE GROUP_NUM = #{group_num}
mapper.update: UPDATE DIAGRAM SET TITLE = #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DIAGRAM_DATA = #{diagram_data, jdbcType=CLOB}, UPDATED_AT = sysdate WHERE GROUP_NUM = #{group_num, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
